issuer: the Licensing Authority of the Ministry of Transport and Road Safety

licence.name: driving licence, grade B (private car), after the new-driver period

note: The Ministry of Education's traffic-education unit on obtaining a licence (traffic-s22-licensing.pdf, dated 9 January 2020), read again 2026-10-31; it states the Traffic Ordinance's and Traffic Regulations' rules, which weren't reachable themselves (Nevo answered 403; the Knesset's fs.knesset.gov.il answered that the site is unavailable from this location; gov.il answers a Cloudflare challenge). For a private car (grade B): the licence is had from at least 16 years and 9 months; one first licensed is a new driver for two years from the day the licence is received, and the licence given to a new driver is valid two years; the permanent-licence stage that follows is a licence of equal standing with all other drivers, with full rights and duties. The full licence is so held from 18 years and 9 months, 16 years 9 months plus the new driver's two years (the unit's other stages agree: the accompaniment ends at 17 years 3 months at the earliest and the young new driver's stage lasts a year and a half): my arithmetic from the unit's stages. A serious offence lengthens the new-driver period two years (not held). The 2020 text is later than the 2013 rule it describes, but no newer statement was reachable, so a change since 2020 isn't ruled out. The full licence's fee and term aren't in the unit, so both are null. Until 2026-10-31 Israel stood blocked because the age falls between birthdays.
